facts.content: Patient has an itchy, dry, sore, red rash lasting a few days, worsening.

facts.content: Rash is distributed on the chest, hands, and arms; worst inside elbows.

facts.content: Patient has a history of eczema and asthma.
Patient uses Diprobase, 'Dermal' in the shower, OTC hydrocortisone, and a blue inhaler as needed.
facts.source_text: DH: Diprobase; “Dermal” in shower; OTC hydrocortisone used/tried; blue inhaler PRN

facts.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

facts.source_text: Rx Betnovate (betamethasone): thin layer BID x 2 wks; very small amounts (fingertip unit guidance)

facts.content: Continue using emollients: Diprobase and 'Dermal' wash.
